signals.title: sudosubin/agents.nix
signals.content: Nixpkgs overlay for AI agent skills from skills.sh and skillsdirectory.com
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance. Final score: 72. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: sudosubin/agents.nix
Source: Nixpkgs overlay that aggregates AI agent skill definitions from the public repositories skills.sh and skillsdirectory.com. The overlay provides a declarative, reproducible way to import, version‑pin, and configure these skill modules within Nix environments. It enables rapid composition of agent capabilities while preserving provenance and allowing OSINT analysts to verify skill provenance through the original repositories. No claims are made about the completeness or performance of the imported skills; verification is required before operational deployment.
signals.brief_ar:
العنوان: sudosubin/agents.nix
المصدر: طبقة Nixpkgs تجمع تعريفات مهارات وكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي من المستودعات العامة skills.sh و skillsdirectory.com. توفّر الطبقة طريقة إعلانية وقابلة لإعادة الإنتاج لاستيراد وتثبيت وإعداد هذه الوحدات داخل بيئات Nix. تمكّن من تركيب قدرات الوكيل بسرعة مع الحفاظ على الأصول والسماح للمحللين في مجال OSINT بالتحقق من مصدر المهارات عبر المستودعات الأصلية. لا تُدعى الطبقة اكتمال أو أداء المهارات المستوردة؛ يلزم التحقق قبل الاستخدام التشغيلي.

Title: silasfelinus/conductor

A service‑agnostic integration platform that enables AI agents to coordinate projects collaboratively. It supports both fully autonomous workflows and human‑in‑the‑loop operations, allowing agents to exchange data, trigger actions, and manage task dependencies across heterogeneous services. signals.brief_en:
Title: Boybo5580/verified-memory-vault

A self‑checking Obsidian vault designed to give AI coding agents persistent, protected memory. It automatically scores vault health, flags corruption, and enforces deletion safeguards to prevent data loss or unauthorized access. The system provides OSINT‑style transparency on integrity metrics while acknowledging uncertainty in detection limits.
